children: Consumers Bancorp Inc /OH/ reported fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $59.4M and net income of $11.16M, driving diluted earnings per share of $3.55, all ahead of the prior year as loan growth and higher rates supported improved margins.
Revenue was $59.4M, compared with $53M in the prior year; YoY change 12%.
Net income was $11.16M, compared with $8.67M in the prior year; YoY change 28.8%.
Diluted EPS was $3.55, compared with $2.77 in the prior year; YoY change 28.2%.
Net income rose 28.8% year over year, driven by a 16.6% increase in net interest income as assets repriced to higher rates.
Loan balances grew 15.3%, supported by expansion in consumer indirect auto lending and increased commercial lending, including a mortgage warehouse line.
Retail engagement strengthened: debit card interchange increased 8.4% and mortgage banking revenue rose 30.3%.
Operational investments included opening two new branches and higher spending on staff, technology and software to support retail and lending growth.
Asset quality improved with a decline in non-performing loans; the allowance for credit losses remained CECL-driven and aligned with peer benchmark methodology and active portfolio monitoring.
